status.detail: The settled narrow candidate retains twenty actual-script real-Git passes against eighteen baseline controls and two expected identity gaps. The seventh Lite review is not convergence. A separately authorized stage-qualified root-only experiment executed once: baseline completed eight vectors, with six controls and two specific log.showRoot=false equal-patch gaps; the candidate passed all eight. Independent readback verified 1,696 retained native stream files with unique stage-qualified paths mapped to actual arguments, exits and hashes. Both stages retain their own raw evidence: baseline history omits the root patch only under the false configuration, while the minimal --root candidate includes it in all configurations. This supports the conditional root omission, not the previously contradicted bare-SHA header premise. Both workers drained naturally, the job closed and the sole lock was released. Earlier failed attempts and the prior capture-overwrite limitation remain preserved, not retrospectively repaired. Finding adjudication is now underway. This focused root-only result is not combined-candidate, full-tree or public-suggestion validation; the root thread, exact-tree review and literal-suggestion gates remain open.
